339-677-1115-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

252-647-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-647-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-6148-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6148-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Seasoned Dungeoneer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

3519-5696-7730.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3519-5696-7730.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
Activate a Forest Dryad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 3 for each Forest Dryad token created in step 2.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling or tapping the Forest Dryads.

1445-2034-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2034-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2292-2577-7390.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2366-4178-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-4178-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-413-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Ambitious Aetherborn trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2743-6106-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-6106-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-6106-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Electroduplicate at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Electroduplicate spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

5256-5913-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Pinnacle Monk.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
5256-5913-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, causing you to mill cards equal to Pinnacle Monk's power.
Cast Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-5658.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonlegendary creature that has haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
3259-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating a token copy of a nontoken nonlegendary creature you control that has haste and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature with Breath of Fury attached, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token with haste, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1247-5614-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5614-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Bighorner Rancher's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

165-1069-1849-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-1849-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

348-2178-2279-2577.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-2178-2279-2577.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

602-679-3749-4778.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
602-679-3749-4778.description:
Activate Cabal Initiate by discarding a card, ensuring to discard Dread if it's in your hand.
Feast of Sanity triggers, and Dread triggers if it was discarded.
Resolve the Dread trigger, shuffling it from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw one card.
Resolve the Cabal Initiate ability, causing it to gain lifelink until end of turn.
Repeat.

3542-3546-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control up to six lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
3542-3546-5003.description:
Activate High Market by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron, gaining 1 life.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, costing you {4} to return Palinchron to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to Palinchron.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping High Market and up to six lands you control that can produce at least {5}.
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Repeat.

570-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Faeburrow Elder.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-4222.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

65-717-875-2628-4652.description:
Activate Fetid Pools's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Fetid Pools, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Fetid Pools trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Fetid Pools and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
